nonClaims: This is a bounded V6-B contact-preserving export/runtime candidate, not G6 or final human visual acceptance.
The sole exported glTF clip is a six-key-pose deformation audit montage with runtime corrective morph channels and midpoint interpolation audits; it is not a production movement-animation matrix.
No LOD set, UV atlas, texture bake, first-person arm set, multiplayer proof, or performance acceptance is claimed.
The exported GLB is isolated evidence and does not replace the current public/player.glb shipping asset.
Rear garment and surface detailing remain sparse and require later human polish acceptance.
